warp.bot: Use this when the user wants to save appointment configuration changes such as timezone, availability, opening-hours synchronization, slot interval, buffer, notice period, or service settings. To keep hours synchronized with a selected native place, pass sync with enabled true after the place is selected; the source comes from the team place, not this input.
